```yaml
name: Clean Unused Strings

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1' # Run every Monday at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check-unused-strings:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.8'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
      
      - name: Detect unused strings
        id: detect-unused
        run: |
          python Tools/detect_unused_strings.py > unused_strings.json
      
      - name: Comment on PR with unused strings
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: |
          cat unused_strings.json | jq -r '.[] | "* " + .category + ": " + (.unused_strings | join(", "))' >> unused_strings_comment.md
          echo "::add-matcher::pr-comment.json"
          echo "::set-output name=comment_path::unused_strings_comment.md"

  clean-unused-strings:
    needs: check-unused-strings
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.8'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
      
      - name: Remove unused strings
        run: |
          python Tools/remove_unused_strings.py
      
      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
          git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
          git add .
          git commit -m "Clean unused localization strings"
          git push origin ${{ github.ref }}
        
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Close PR if no changes made
        if: needs.clean-unused-strings.outputs.comment_path == ''
        run: |
          gh pr close ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --message "No unused strings found."
```
